.archium11-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #53685370;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.archium11-row strong{display:block;font-weight:750;font-size:13px}
.archium11-row small{display:block;color:#a3b69e;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5}
.archium11-row input[type=checkbox]{min-width:20px;width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:#e0c374;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.archium11-group{border-top:1px solid #53685370;padding:12px 0}
.archium11-group label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#dfdbbd;margin-bottom:10px}
.archium11-panel select,.archium11-panel input[type=range]{width:100%;min-height:36px;accent-color:#dfbd65}
.archium11-panel select{background:#0b1810;color:#f0e7ca;border:1px solid #7d936e;padding:8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px}
.archium11-button{display:block;width:100%;min-height:39px;padding:10px;background:#263929;color:#e9d39e;border:1px solid #b6a467;border-radius:4px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.archium11-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0d387;outline-offset:2px}
.archium11-state{font:11px/1.4 Consolas,monospace;color:#9cbb9d;margin-top:11px}
.archium11-muted{color:#afbaa7;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:7px}
/* Prevent overscroll swallowing PDA gestures on Safari while preserving vertical scrolling. */
#home,#simple,.v61-body,.v61-list{overscroll-behavior-y:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
@media(max-width:710px){.archium11-panel{padding:12px;margin:14px 0}.archium11-row{gap:8px}.archium11-heading{font-size:13px}}
</style>
<style id="archium-v630-weapon-specs">
.archium-wpn-specs{margin:14px 0 17px;border:1px solid #667a4d;background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(30,46,30,.97),rgba(10,20,14,.97));padding:14px;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #98ae5833}
.archium-wpn-heading{font-weight:800;color:#d7bc73;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:11px;margin:0 0 12px}
.archium-wpn-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.archium-wpn-cell{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;border:1px solid #415645;padding:10px;background:#15241a;border-radius:3px}
.archium-wpn-label{color:#96af91;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.09em}
.archium-wpn-value{color:#ebeddd;font-size:14px;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.archium-wpn-disclaimer{color:#acb9a8;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin:10px 0 0}
@media(max-width:370px){.archium-wpn-grid{gap:6px}.archium-wpn-cell{padding:8px}.archium-wpn-value{font-size:12px}}
@media(min-width:800px){.archium-wpn-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
</style><style id="archium-v631-weapons">.archium-wpn-specs .archium-wpn-grid{align-items:stretch}.archium-wpn-specs .archium-wpn-value{word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.archium-wpn-specs .archium-wpn-heading{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}</style><style id="archium-v632-anomaly-styles">
/* ARCHIUM v6.32 — field guide for canonical trilogy anomalies */
.anomaly-filterbar[hidden]{display:none!important}
.anomaly-filterbar{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #756538;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#192719,#0a130e);scrollbar-color:#6c744b #101710;min-height:43px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;flex:none}
.anomaly-type-pill{flex:none;white-space:nowrap;min-height:27px;padding:5px 11px;border:1px solid #5c6b4d;border-radius:4px;background:#101b14;color:#c4cebd;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.35px;cursor:pointer}
.anomaly-type-pill[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#d7b561;color:#ffe7a7;background:#4b3920;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #d7b56155}
.anomaly-type-pill:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e2bb60;outline-offset:1px}
.archium-anomaly-protocol{--ac:#b5c08f;border:1px solid #606840;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101e18,#08120d);margin:14px 0 19px;padding:0;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0005,inset 0 1px #bec08b25;overflow:hidden}
.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="gravity"]{--ac:#e0c276}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="electric"]{--ac:#83d3eb}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="thermal"]{--ac:#f0a76e}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="chemical"]{--ac:#98ce7b}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="organic"]{--ac:#bed6a0}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="space"]{--ac:#c7b1e7}.archium-anomaly-protocol[data-class="complex"]{--ac:#dfaa9b}
.archium-anomaly-protocol-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#41412a88,#142119);border-bottom:1px solid #8b8b6040;padding:13px 14px}
.archium-anomaly-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ac) 50%,transparent);background:#09140f;color:var(--ac);font-size:26px}
.archium-anomaly-protocol-title{flex:1;min-width:0}.archium-anomaly-protocol-title b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#f3e9ce;letter-spacing:.05em}.archium-anomaly-protocol-title small{display:block;color:#a8b7a4;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}
.archium-anomaly-risk{display:inline-flex;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.35px;color:var(--ac);text-align:right;max-width:95px;line-height:1.4}
.archium-anomaly-protocol-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:11px}
.archium-anomaly-cell{padding:11px;background:#17231b;border:1px solid #54634558;min-width:0;border-radius:3px}
.archium-anomaly-cell span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--ac);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:.55px}
.archium-anomaly-cell p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#dce0d0;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.archium-anomaly-rule{margin:0 11px 12px!important;padding:9px 10px!important;color:#c3c8b5!important;border-left:2px solid var(--ac);background:#0b160f;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.55}
.archium-anomaly-rule strong{color:var(--ac)}
.archium-anomaly-protocol-caption{font-size:9px!important;line-height:1.5;color:#849782!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 11px 12px}
@media(max-width:710px){.anomaly-filterbar{padding:6px 8px}.anomaly-type-pill{font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px}.archium-anomaly-protocol-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}.archium-anomaly-protocol-head{padding:10px;gap:8px}.archium-anomaly-risk{font-size:8px}.archium-anomaly-mark{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:24px}.archium-anomaly-cell{padding:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.anomaly-type-pill{transition:none!important}}
</style>
<style id="archium-v633-crosslinks">
/* АРХИУМ v6.33 — двусторонние связи артефактов и аномалий */
.archium-crossmap{margin:16px 0 18px;padding:0;border:1px solid #81703f;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#17291d,#0b1811);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #779b5140,0 7px 22px #0005}
.archium-crossmap-head{padding:14px 15px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #81703f70;background:linear-gradient(95deg,#273a24,#14251a)}
.archium-crossmap-head strong{display:block;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f4d78e}
.archium-crossmap-head small{display:block;color:#adbca4;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.55}
.archium-crossmap-game{padding:12px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid #a2a66a22}
.archium-crossmap-game:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.archium-crossmap-game-title{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:9px;color:#d9d9b2;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.archium-crossmap-game-title span{display:inline-block;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:3px;background:#4a5735;border:1px solid #81915b;font-size:11px;color:#fff1c5}
.archium-crossmap-chipwrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.archium-crossmap-chip{cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #96834d;border-radius:5px;background:#273b29;color:#f4e5b9;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-align:left;min-height:39px;max-width:100%;white-space:normal;line-height:1.35;transition:background .14s,border-color .14s}
.archium-crossmap-chip:hover,.archium-crossmap-chip:focus-visible{background:#40523a;border-color:#eac971;outline-offset:2px}
.archium-crossmap-desc{padding:10px 15px 13px;color:#aebda7;line-height:1.55;font-size:11px;border-top:1px solid #7f874325;margin:0}
.archium-crossmap-empty{padding:12px 15px;color:#bec7b5;line-height:1.6;font-size:12px}
.archium-crossmap-empty strong{color:#e8d19c}
@media(max-width:710px){.archium-crossmap-head{padding:12px 10px}.archium-crossmap-game{padding:11px 10px}.archium-crossmap-chip{font-size:12px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 10px}.archium-crossmap-desc,.archium-crossmap-empty{padding:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.archium-crossmap-chip{transition:none}}
</style>
<style id="archium-v634-anomaly-dossier">
/* v6.34 | Полевой архив. Only anomaly dossiers, preserves v6.33 source data. */
.reading[data-anomaly-class]{--case-color:#d3c07f}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="gravity"]{--case-color:#e0c276}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="thermal"]{--case-color:#ffab6a}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="electric"]{--case-color:#77d6ef}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="chemical"]{--case-color:#a0d989}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="organic"]{--case-color:#c2df9c}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="space"]{--case-color:#c5a9e9}
.reading[data-anomaly-class="complex"]{--case-color:#ecaa9c}
.reading[data-anomaly-class]>h2{color:var(--case-color);font-size:clamp(27px,3.2vw,39px);letter-spacing:.04em;text-shadow:0 2px 15px #0009}
.reading[data-anomaly-class]>.minihead{color:var(--case-color)}
.reading[data-anomaly-class]>.lead{border-left:2px solid var(--case-color);padding-left:12px;margin:9px 0 12px}
.reading[data-anomaly-class]>.databits .bit:first-child{color:var(--case-color);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 55%,transparent)}
.archium-anomaly-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(205px,.8fr);max-width:none;margin:10px 0 7px;gap:10px}
.archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-image{height:clamp(255px,28vw,360px);border:1px solid var(--case-color);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0c120d,0 9px 26px #000a;overflow:hidden}
.archium-anomaly-hero .anomaly-dossier-art{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 50%}
.archium-anomaly-hero .anomaly-dossier-image::after{font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:1px!important;text-align:left!important;color:#f0e1b8!important;padding:11px 12px!important}
.archium-anomaly-hero-hud{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:10px;left:10px;right:10px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.archium-anomaly-hero-hud span{display:inline-flex;min-height:27px;align-items:center;max-width:100%;padding:6px 9px;background:#06100de5;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 70%,transparent);font:800 10px/1.4 Consolas,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--case-color);text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000}
.archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 30%,#48523c);background:linear-gradient(153deg,#1a2a20,#0c1610);gap:10px}
.archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes b{color:var(--case-color)}
.archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes .image-disclaimer{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}
.archium-anomaly-jumps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:5px 0 13px}
.archium-anomaly-jump{flex:1 1 170px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 45%,#414836);border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#19291c,#0b1710);color:#e6d6b3;text-align:left;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;transition:border-color .12s,background .12s}
.archium-anomaly-jump:hover,.archium-anomaly-jump:focus-visible{border-color:var(--case-color);background:#2b3522;color:#fff4d2}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-protocol{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 50%,#46553a);border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0005;margin:14px 0}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-cell{border-color:#526c4a57;background:#132219}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-cell p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-protocol-caption{font-size:10px!important}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .canonical-anomalies{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--case-color) 45%,#5b683e);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-panel-title{font-size:14px!important;color:var(--case-color);background:linear-gradient(95deg,#2d3822,#101b12)}
.archium-anomaly-game-switch{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 12px;background:#0b1710;border-bottom:1px solid #53603a}
.archium-anomaly-game-switch button{flex:1 1 60px;min-width:48px;padding:9px 10px;min-height:39px;border:1px solid #556446;background:#18261b;color:#c7cdb8;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;border-radius:3px;transition:background .12s}
.archium-anomaly-game-switch button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--case-color);color:#10170f;border-color:var(--case-color)}
.archium-anomaly-game-switch button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]){color:#f3e1ad;border-color:#c7b365}
.archium-anomaly-game-hint{padding:9px 12px 0;font-size:11px;color:#adbca3;line-height:1.5}
.archium-anomaly-game-stat{font-size:11px;color:#96bf9d;letter-spacing:.03em;margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.5}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row{padding:15px 16px}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row h4{font-size:14px;color:var(--case-color)}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-places{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-artifact-chip{min-height:39px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;border-radius:4px}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-artifact-chip:not(:disabled):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--case-color)}
@media(max-width:710px){
 .reading[data-anomaly-class]{padding:13px 13px 25px}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class]>h2{font-size:28px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;margin:12px 0 8px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-image{height:clamp(240px,67vw,335px)}
 .archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes{border-top:0;padding:10px 12px;gap:5px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes b{font-size:11px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes span{font-size:11px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero .dossier-notes .image-disclaimer{padding-top:7px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero-hud{top:7px;left:7px;right:7px;gap:5px}
 .archium-anomaly-hero-hud span{padding:6px;font-size:9px;min-height:24px}
 .archium-anomaly-jumps{gap:6px;margin:9px 0}
 .archium-anomaly-jump{flex-basis:125px;min-height:42px;font-size:10px;padding:8px}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-protocol-grid{gap:7px}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-cell p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .canonical-anomalies{margin:13px 0}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row{padding:13px 12px}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row h4{font-size:13px}
 .reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row .anomaly-artifact-chip{font-size:12px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.archium-anomaly-jump,.archium-anomaly-game-switch button{transition:none!important}}
.device.no-effects .archium-anomaly-jump,.device.no-effects .archium-anomaly-game-switch button{transition:none!important}
</style>
<style id="archium-v635-game-canonicity">
/* Game-accurate factual panels — only in anomaly dossiers. */
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .canonical-anomalies{margin-top:20px}
.archium-true-game-card{margin:11px 0 14px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #637555;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#15241a,#08120d);border-left:3px solid var(--case-color);border-radius:4px}
.archium-true-game-label{color:var(--case-color);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.6}
.archium-true-game-part{padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid #5e6b473d}
.archium-true-game-part span{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#b1c4a4}
.archium-true-game-part p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#e1e5d6;margin:6px 0 0}
.archium-true-game-note{margin:10px 0;padding:9px 11px;background:#24341e;border:1px solid #4c6540;color:#cad9b9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
.archium-true-game-source{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;color:#f2d37e;border-bottom:1px dashed #b69b55;padding:7px 0;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.archium-true-game-source:hover{color:#fff1c9}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-game-row[hidden]{display:none!important}
.archium-anomaly-hero .anomaly-dossier-image:after{content:'АВТОРСКАЯ ИЛЛЮСТРАЦИЯ / НЕ СКРИНШОТ ИЗ ИГРЫ'!important}
@media(max-width:710px){.archium-true-game-card{padding:11px 10px;margin:9px 0 12px}.archium-true-game-label{font-size:10px}.archium-true-game-part p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.68}.archium-true-game-note{font-size:11px}}
</style><style id="archium-v640-style">
/* ARKHIUM 6.40 — factual artifact dossiers, mobile-safe rendering */
.a640-dossier-media{height:240px!important;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:#081410!important;padding:0!important}
.a640-dossier-media::after{display:none!important}
.a640-piece{--a640-glow:160,160,230;--a640-accent:#c3c7ed;position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 70% at 50% 53%,rgba(var(--a640-glow),.22),transparent 67%),linear-gradient(130deg,#0d2018,#070d0b 70%)}
.a640-piece:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:168px;height:168px;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-55%) rotate(13deg);border:1px solid rgba(var(--a640-glow),.5);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(var(--a640-glow),.23),inset 0 0 60px rgba(var(--a640-glow),.2)}
.a640-piece:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:11%;bottom:14%;left:49.8%;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(var(--a640-glow),.32),transparent);transform:rotate(23deg)}
.a640-corner{position:absolute;top:11px;left:13px;color:#dcd4ab;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;z-index:1}
.a640-glyph{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:91px;line-height:1;color:var(--a640-accent);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 21px rgba(var(--a640-glow),.85));z-index:1;position:relative;margin-top:-22px;animation:a640-glow 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.a640-object-title{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:11px;color:#f4e4b3;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 3px 8px #000}
.a640-render-label{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:9px;right:9px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#aaae91;background:#08140dc4;padding:6px 2px;letter-spacing:.5px}
@keyframes a640-glow{to{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 36px rgba(var(--a640-glow),1));transform:scale(1.025)}}
.a640-main{border:1px solid rgba(var(--a640-glow),.45);background:linear-gradient(130deg,#111e17,#08120e);margin:18px 0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 33px rgba(var(--a640-glow),.05)}
.a640-header{padding:18px 18px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--a640-glow),.28)}.a640-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.7px;color:var(--a640-accent)}
.a640-header h3{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,23px);color:#f6daa0;margin:9px 0 11px;line-height:1.2}
.a640-chips{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.a640-chips span{border:1px solid #625d41;color:#d6d2bb;background:#0c160f;padding:5px 9px;font-size:10px}
.a640-lead{font-size:13px;color:#cbd7c5;line-height:1.65;padding:10px 18px 2px;margin:8px 0}
.a640-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin:11px 18px 0}
.a640-tab{border:1px solid #5c6b4a;background:#0a1810;color:#ddd4aa;padding:12px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.a640-tab[aria-pressed="true"]{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#f1d076,#a7863a);color:#11180d;border-color:#e6c66c}
.a640-gameview{padding:10px 18px 17px}.a640-gameview h4{font-size:14px;color:var(--a640-accent);letter-spacing:1px;margin:12px 0}
.a640-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.a640-statbox{min-height:85px;border:1px solid #526349;background:#102219;padding:12px}.a640-statbox.bad{border-color:#795844;background:#231b14}.a640-statbox b{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#9bd1a4}.a640-statbox.bad b{color:#edb095}.a640-statbox p{color:#e3dfc9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;margin:9px 0 0}
.a640-statbox p.a640-muted,.a640-muted{color:#9caa92!important;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.6}
.a640-absent{border-left:3px solid #92733d;padding:11px;background:#1e2118;color:#e4d1a5;font-size:13px}
.a640-game-note{background:#1e291a;border-left:3px solid var(--a640-accent);padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#dcdac6}
.a640-locations{margin:14px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #4e6044;background:#0d1911}.a640-locations h5{font-size:11px;color:#e3c672;margin:0 0 11px;letter-spacing:.9px}
.a640-anomaly-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.a640-anomaly{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #8e7a47;background:#1b2a19;color:#f0d691;font-size:11px}.a640-anomaly:hover{background:#324125}.a640-locations ul{padding-left:20px;margin:12px 0}.a640-locations li{font-size:11px;color:#cbd1b9;margin:5px 0}
.a640-sources{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:13px;font-size:10px;color:#a5ba9e}.a640-sources a{border-bottom:1px solid #b1a069;color:#e4ca84;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-decoration:none}
.a640-caution{border-top:1px solid #4f573a;padding:12px 18px 15px;margin:0;color:#aeb69e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
@media(max-width:710px){.a640-dossier-media{height:225px!important}.a640-main{margin:13px 0}.a640-header{padding:12px 11px}.a640-lead{padding:7px 11px 0}.a640-tabs{margin:9px 11px 0}.a640-gameview{padding:8px 11px 13px}.a640-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.a640-tab{min-height:44px}.a640-glyph{font-size:77px}.a640-object-title{font-size:17px}.a640-caution{padding:11px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.a640-glyph{animation:none}}
.device.no-effects .a640-glyph{animation:none!important}
</style>
<style id="archium-v643-season-anomaly">/* АРХИУМ v6.43 / seasonal scenery, anomaly-only UI enhancements */
body{--a643-shade:.65;background-image:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(2,7,6,var(--a643-shade)),rgba(3,8,7,.42) 52%,rgba(2,5,4,var(--a643-shade))),var(--a643-scene)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-attachment:fixed!important}
body:before{opacity:.22!important;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;z-index:0}.device{z-index:1}
/* Separate outer glass and device highlights, never blocking controls */
@media(min-width:711px){.device{border-color:#555d4e!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #080c0a,0 0 0 6px #3a4139,0 25px 85px #000, inset 0 2px 1px #8f987e,inset 0 -6px 20px #000!important}.screen{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #050907,inset 0 0 20px #000,0 0 11px #000,0 0 0 1px #cbb07135!important}.device:before{border-color:#b3b29b47}}
.device .hardware .led{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #65d85b)}
/* Anomaly hero always remains larger, with clear provenance */
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-hero{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(195px,.55fr);max-width:none}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-dossier-image{height:340px;min-height:260px;border:1px solid #b69a5b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px #000b,0 10px 27px #0009;position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-dossier-art{object-fit:cover;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:zoom-in}
.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-dossier-image:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.42;background:linear-gradient(111deg,transparent 38%,#ffffff10 49%,transparent 55%);transform:translateX(-120%)}
.reading[data-anomaly-class].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image:before{animation:a643-beam 9s linear infinite}
@keyframes a643-beam{0%,77%{transform:translateX(-130%)}100%{transform:translateX(130%)}}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='electric'].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image{box-shadow:0 0 22px #7ecde834,inset 0 0 16px #0b354077}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='electric'].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image .anomaly-dossier-art{animation:a643-electric 6s steps(1,end) infinite}
@keyframes a643-electric{0%,80%,86%,100%{filter:contrast(1.07) saturate(.94)}81%,84%{filter:contrast(1.4) brightness(1.22) saturate(1.32)}}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='thermal'].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image{box-shadow:0 0 23px #e47a3630,inset 0 0 18px #b858223a}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='thermal'].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image .anomaly-dossier-art{animation:a643-heat 8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes a643-heat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.023)}}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='gravity'].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image .anomaly-dossier-art{animation:a643-grav 11s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes a643-grav{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}45%{transform:scale(1.025) rotate(.25deg)}}
/* Real image cards within existing v6.42 game comparison */
.a643-shot-preview{display:block;position:relative;margin:0 10px 9px;padding:0;border:1px solid #52624a;border-radius:4px;height:142px;overflow:hidden;background:#060d0b;cursor:zoom-in;text-align:left;color:#e1e1c5}
.a643-shot-preview:hover{border-color:#dfc16e}.a643-shot-preview:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffe6a3;outline-offset:2px}
.a643-shot-preview-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:contrast(1.05)}
.a643-preview-type{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:8px 9px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#07100af5,#08160cb3);color:#f0d28d;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.a643-shot-preview[data-fallback='true'] .a643-preview-type{color:#f0b195}
/* Bolt demo is deliberately framed as illustrative, not as an interactive shooter */
.a643-bolt{--a643-color:#dfbf76;border:1px solid #655d3c;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#18231a,#0a140e);padding:15px;margin:16px 0 18px;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 8px 23px #0007}
.reading[data-anomaly-class='electric'] .a643-bolt{--a643-color:#8cdbf8}.reading[data-anomaly-class='thermal'] .a643-bolt{--a643-color:#f1a467}.reading[data-anomaly-class='chemical'] .a643-bolt{--a643-color:#a2dca0}
.a643-bolt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--a643-color);font-weight:900;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.05em}.a643-bolt-head span{font-size:10px;color:#a2b09c;font-weight:600}
.a643-bolt-stage{position:relative;overflow:hidden;height:153px;border:1px solid #536149;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 68% 70%,#33433559,transparent 42%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#91bb8411 0 1px,transparent 1px 34px),linear-gradient(#0c1912,#08110e);border-radius:3px;isolation:isolate}
.a643-bolt-stage:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:30%;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#293c2d92,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.a643-bolt-target{position:absolute;left:64%;top:51%;width:84px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:1px dashed #8dad806b;box-shadow:0 0 40px #bece9440,inset 0 0 22px #8ab77a29;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--a643-color);font-size:32px;text-shadow:0 0 18px var(--a643-color);transition:box-shadow .2s}
.a643-bolt-target:after{content:'ПОЛЕ';position:absolute;bottom:-22px;font-size:9px;color:#a0b6a3;letter-spacing:.11em}
.a643-bolt-nut{position:absolute;left:8%;top:50%;color:#eee1bd;font-size:29px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-30deg);text-shadow:0 2px 7px #000}
.a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-nut{animation:a643-throw .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards}
.a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-target{animation:a643-trigger .8s ease-out .5s forwards}
@keyframes a643-throw{0%{left:8%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-30deg)}65%{left:61%;top:53%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(450deg)}100%{left:67%;top:60%;opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(530deg)}}
@keyframes a643-trigger{0%{filter:brightness(1)}40%{filter:brightness(3);box-shadow:0 0 65px 22px var(--a643-color)}100%{filter:brightness(1);box-shadow:0 0 30px var(--a643-color)}}
.a643-bolt-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}.a643-bolt-go{min-height:46px;background:#b79445;border:1px solid #f5d485;border-radius:4px;color:#131b11;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:900}.a643-bolt-go:disabled{opacity:.65}.a643-bolt-result{flex:1;min-width:190px;color:#b8cbb1;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.a643-bolt-desc{font-size:10px;color:#a0b09e;line-height:1.5;margin-top:9px}
/* Settings */
.a643-season-settings{padding:16px;margin:16px 0;border:1px solid #7a6945;background:#111e16;border-radius:7px;max-width:830px}
.a643-season-settings h3{margin:0 0 9px;color:#f4d484;font-size:19px}.a643-season-settings p{color:#b3c3aa;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.a643-season-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.a643-season-controls label{font-size:12px;color:#e0d1a7;display:grid;gap:7px}.a643-season-controls select,.a643-season-controls input{width:100%;color:#eddec0;accent-color:#dfba63;background:#0b160d;border:1px solid #72643d;min-height:43px;padding:8px 10px}.a643-season-badge{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #82713e;color:#f0d188;background:#272819;padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}
/* Fullscreen in-page image viewer */
.a643-lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10005;display:none;place-items:center;background:#000e;padding:20px}.a643-lightbox.open{display:grid}.a643-lightbox-box{max-width:min(1100px,97vw);width:100%;max-height:95dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.a643-lightbox-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#f1d488;gap:10px}.a643-lightbox-close{color:#e6d28b;background:#172319;border:1px solid #e0c270;padding:9px 12px;min-width:48px;min-height:44px}.a643-lightbox img{width:100%;object-fit:contain;min-height:0;max-height:76dvh;border:1px solid #8b793f;background:#09110a}.a643-lightbox-caption{font-size:12px;color:#d0d3b7;line-height:1.5}.a643-lightbox-src{color:#e9c570;font-size:12px}
/* mobile: keep reading panel from overlapping buttons and improve tap size */
@media(max-width:710px){.reading[data-anomaly-class] .archium-anomaly-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-dossier-image{height:260px;min-height:220px}.a643-bolt{margin:12px 0;padding:10px}.a643-bolt-stage{height:139px}.a643-bolt-head{font-size:13px}.a643-bolt-go{width:100%}.a643-shot-preview{height:174px}.a642-open,.a642-mark,.anomaly-artifact-chip,.archium-anomaly-game-switch button{min-height:44px}.window-main .back-to-list{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:#1a2b1b;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0008;min-height:44px}.a643-season-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr}.a643-lightbox{padding:8px}.a643-lightbox img{max-height:70dvh}}
@media(max-width:380px){.a643-shot-preview{height:145px}.a643-bolt-result{min-width:0}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reading[data-anomaly-class] .anomaly-dossier-image:before,.reading[data-anomaly-class].a643-live .anomaly-dossier-image .anomaly-dossier-art,.a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-nut,.a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-target{animation:none!important}}
.device.no-effects .a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-nut,.device.no-effects .a643-bolt-stage.is-firing .a643-bolt-target{animation:none!important}
</style><style id="archium-v644-editorial-style">
/* ARCHIUM v6.44 · factual audit overlay within the existing anomaly dossier only */
.a644-summary{margin:12px 13px 4px;border:1px solid #7b6f45;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#253026,#0c1511);border-radius:5px;padding:15px;color:#e8e4c8}
.a644-summary .a644-kicker{display:block;color:#e6c880;font:800 10px/1.6 Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}
.a644-summary h4{color:#f8d995;font-size:17px;margin:6px 0 7px!important}
.a644-summary p{color:#ced9c9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;margin:7px 0}
.a644-summary .a644-note{border-top:1px solid #556349;margin-top:12px;padding-top:10px;color:#e4c699}
.a644-proof{margin:13px 0 8px;padding:12px 14px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#202b21,#0d1710);border-left:3px solid #ac9556;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #536149;color:#d6dfcc}
.a644-proof b{color:#ffe0a0;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.a644-proof p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;margin:7px 0}
.a644-proof a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 11px;color:#e6d08b;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;font-size:11px;word-break:break-word;border:1px solid #6e6945;border-radius:4px;background:#131f18}
.a644-proof small{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#a5b6a6;line-height:1.5}
.a643-bolt-stage[data-bolt-react="no"] .a643-bolt-target,.a643-bolt-stage[data-bolt-react="unknown"] .a643-bolt-target,.a643-bolt-stage[data-bolt-react="not-applicable"] .a643-bolt-target{animation:none!important}
@media(max-width:710px){.a644-summary{padding:12px;margin:10px 8px 4px}.a644-proof{padding:10px 11px;margin:9px 0}.a644-proof a{width:100%;justify-content:center;text-align:center}}
</style>

<style id="archium-v645-artifact-layout">
/* v6.45 — original tri-game artifact research layer; never touches other categories */
.a645-compare{--ac:#dcb975;margin:13px 0 17px;border:1px solid #82754c;border-radius:7px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(153deg,#1a2419,#0c150f 79%);box-shadow:0 9px 22px #0007}
.reading[data-artifact-family="electric"] .a645-compare{--ac:#8ddaff}.reading[data-artifact-family="thermal"] .a645-compare{--ac:#f3b17a}.reading[data-artifact-family="chemical"] .a645-compare{--ac:#aae39c}.reading[data-artifact-family="gravity"] .a645-compare{--ac:#d3c0ef}.reading[data-artifact-family="radiation"] .a645-compare{--ac:#efd07d}
.a645-heading{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(95deg,#685a3029,transparent);border-bottom:1px solid #546044;padding:15px}
.a645-heading h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--ac);font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.05em}
.a645-heading p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#c9d3c1;margin:0;max-width:750px}
.a645-count{font:700 11px/1.45 Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#e9d5a4;border:1px solid #726744;padding:7px 9px;white-space:nowrap;background:#111b13}
.a645-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:12px}
.a645-card{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(#17261a,#101912);border:1px solid #5d6c4d;border-radius:5px}
.a645-card[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.66;background:#111913}
.a645-cardtitle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;border-bottom:1px solid #4b5a42;padding-bottom:10px}
.a645-game{font-size:22px;color:var(--ac);font-weight:900}
.a645-name{font-size:10px;color:#abbba5;text-align:right}
.a645-status{color:#c1d3a4;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.04em}
.a645-subtitle{font-size:10px;color:#e5c781;letter-spacing:.07em;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:5px}
.a645-property{font-size:12px;color:#dce2d5;line-height:1.5;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.a645-property.good{color:#afdfb1}.a645-property.bad{color:#f0b79a}
.a645-block{border-top:1px solid #3c503d;padding-top:10px}.a645-block p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#c8cfba;margin:0 0 6px}
.a645-link{margin-top:auto;align-self:stretch;min-height:43px;padding:9px;text-align:left;color:#f4dfa9;background:#28341e;border:1px solid #95804a;border-radius:3px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.a645-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f4d589;outline-offset:2px}.a645-link:hover{background:#34462a}
.a645-src{font-size:11px;color:#e4d29b;text-decoration:underline;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal;line-height:1.5}
.a645-note{margin:0 12px 12px;border-left:3px solid #b7a15c;background:#283221;padding:11px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#e5e3ce}
.a645-disclaimer{margin:0;padding:11px 15px;border-top:1px solid #48573f;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#afbca9}
.a645-nav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 12px 11px}.a645-nav button{color:#e4c989;background:#15271b;border:1px solid #766945;padding:9px 12px;min-height:42px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.a645-subnote{color:#bfc8b2;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 12px 10px}
.a645-srchighlight{outline:2px solid #dcc477;outline-offset:4px}
@media(max-width:980px){.a645-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.a645-card{gap:8px}.a645-block{padding-top:8px}.a645-heading h3{font-size:16px}}
@media(max-width:710px){.a645-heading{padding:12px}.a645-list{padding:8px;gap:8px}.a645-card{padding:12px}.a645-note{margin:0 8px 8px}.a645-nav{margin:0 8px 8px}.a645-disclaimer{padding:9px}.a645-link{min-height:46px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.a645-compare *{scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>

<style id="archium-v646-mutant-style">
/* Mutant field guide: no influence on artifacts, anomaly dossier rendering, or site navigation */
.m646-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;min-height:190px;border:1px solid #94744e!important}
.m646-hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(7,14,11,.08),rgba(6,14,11,.83)),repeating-linear-gradient(145deg,transparent 0 16px,rgba(229,183,95,.035) 17px 18px);pointer-events:none}
.m646-hero-stamp{position:absolute;inset:auto 12px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#ead9b4;font:700 11px/1.6 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;text-shadow:0 2px 4px black;letter-spacing:.07em}
.m646-hero-stamp strong{font:800 24px/1.1 system-ui;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#f5c87b;text-transform:uppercase}
.m646-root{--m646-accent:#c9c991;margin:13px 0;border:1px solid #5d6853;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#18221c,#0b120f);color:#e6e7d9;box-shadow:0 9px 20px #0008}
.m646-root[data-group="psi"]{--m646-accent:#a0d6dc}.m646-root[data-group="thermal"]{--m646-accent:#f5a76a}.m646-root[data-group="anomalous"]{--m646-accent:#c1b9e9}.m646-root[data-group="humanoid"]{--m646-accent:#c3d5a0}
.m646-top{padding:15px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #465442;background:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(158,179,105,.1),transparent)}
.m646-title{margin:0 0 4px!important;font-size:20px!important;color:var(--m646-accent)!important;letter-spacing:.07em}
.m646-kicker{color:#b9c6b5;font-size:11px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:1.5}
.m646-badges{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0 0}.m646-badge{display:inline-block;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #5d7054;color:#d9e3c7;background:#152119;font:700 10px/1.45 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.m646-badge.warning{border-color:#8e6648;color:#f0cba2;background:#2b1c17}
.m646-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:12px}
.m646-fact{background:#142019;border:1px solid #3e5547;border-radius:5px;padding:11px;min-width:0}
.m646-fact h4{color:var(--m646-accent);margin:0 0 7px!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.08em}
.m646-fact p{margin:0!important;color:#d2dfd2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.m646-game-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:13px 14px 10px;border-top:1px solid #455c4b}
.m646-game-header h4{margin:0!important;color:var(--m646-accent);font-size:15px!important;letter-spacing:.05em}
.m646-switch{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.m646-switch button{border:1px solid #647658;border-radius:3px;background:#122016;color:#cdddbf;padding:9px 11px;min-height:39px;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}
.m646-switch button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#5b6a39;color:#fff9dc;border-color:#d3b977}
.m646-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;padding:10px 12px 13px}
.m646-card{padding:12px;background:#111d16;border:1px solid #4b634d;border-radius:4px;min-width:0}
.m646-card[hidden]{display:none!important}.m646-card.m646-none{opacity:.6;background:#111613}
.m646-card h5{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--m646-accent)}
.m646-card h5 span{font-size:10px;color:#b8c5b4;font-weight:400;display:block}
.m646-card .m646-label{display:block;color:#c7b777;margin:11px 0 5px;font:800 10px/1.6 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.m646-card p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:0;color:#d6dfcd;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.m646-card a{display:inline-block;color:#e9d199;text-decoration:underline;font-size:11px;margin-top:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.m646-caution{border-left:3px solid #db9e59;background:#2b281c;margin:0 12px 12px;padding:11px 13px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#eedfc4}
.m646-caption{border-top:1px solid #39493e;padding:11px 14px;margin:0!important;color:#aeb9a7;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:1050px){.m646-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.m646-card{padding:12px}.m646-card .m646-label{margin-top:8px}}
@media(max-width:710px){.m646-overview{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:9px}.m646-top{padding:12px}.m646-title{font-size:18px!important}.m646-cards{padding:8px;gap:8px}.m646-game-header{padding:11px}.m646-switch{width:100%}.m646-switch button{flex:1;min-height:44px}.m646-hero{min-height:170px}.m646-hero-stamp strong{font-size:19px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.m646-root,.m646-root *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>

<script id="archium-v646-mutant-engine">
(()=>{'use strict';
window.ARCHIUM_MUTANT_V646={
 mount(record,root,hero){
  if(record.cat!=='mutants'||!record.mutantField)return;
  const m=record.mutantField, mk=(tag,cl,txt)=>{const x=document.createElement(tag);if(cl)x.className=cl;if(txt!==undefined)x.textContent=txt;return x};
  hero.classList.add('m646-hero');
  const stamp=mk('div','m646-hero-stamp');stamp.append(mk('strong','',record.name),mk('span','','АРХИВ МУТАНТОВ / '+record.id));hero.append(stamp);
  const layer=mk('section','m646-root');layer.dataset.group=m.group;layer.setAttribute('aria-label','Полевое досье мутанта: '+record.name);
  const top=mk('header','m646-top');top.append(mk('h3','m646-title','◈ БИОЛОГИЧЕСКОЕ ДОСЬЕ'),mk('div','m646-kicker',m.kind));
  const badges=mk('div','m646-badges');badges.append(mk('span','m646-badge warning','УГРОЗА · '+m.threat),mk('span','m646-badge','ОРИГИНАЛЬНАЯ ТРИЛОГИЯ'),mk('span','m646-badge','ИГРЫ · '+record.games));top.append(badges);layer.append(top);
  const overview=mk('div','m646-overview');
  for(const [name,value] of [['ОПОЗНАВАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ПРИЗНАКИ',m.signs],['СПОСОБ НАПАДЕНИЯ',m.attack],['ТАКТИКА ПРОТИВОДЕЙСТВИЯ',m.defence],['КЛАССИФИКАЦИЯ',m.kind]]){
   const cell=mk('section','m646-fact');cell.append(mk('h4','',name),mk('p','',value));overview.append(cell)
  }layer.append(overview);
  const bar=mk('div','m646-game-header');bar.append(mk('h4','','РАЗЛИЧИЯ ТЧ / ЧН / ЗП'));
  const switches=mk('div','m646-switch');switches.setAttribute('role','group');switches.setAttribute('aria-label','Выберите игру для сравнения мутантов');
  const cards=mk('div','m646-cards'), map={}, buttons={};
  const games={ТЧ:'Тень Чернобыля',ЧН:'Чистое Небо',ЗП:'Зов Припяти'};
  for(const [g,full] of Object.entries(games)){
   const data=m.games[g],card=mk('article','m646-card'+(data?'':' m646-none'));map[g]=card;
   const head=mk('h5','',g);head.append(mk('span','',full));card.append(head);
   if(data){
     card.append(mk('span','m646-label','ПОДТВЕРЖДЁННЫЕ ПРИМЕРЫ МЕСТ'),mk('p','',data.where),mk('span','m646-label','ОСОБЕННОСТИ'),mk('p','',data.behavior));
     if(data.note)card.append(mk('span','m646-label','УТОЧНЕНИЕ'),mk('p','',data.note));
     const link=mk('a','','СВЕРИТЬ С ИСТОЧНИКОМ ↗');link.href=m.source||{ТЧ:'https://stalker.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_mutants_in_Shadow_of_Chernobyl',ЧН:'https://stalker.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_mutants_in_Clear_Sky',ЗП:'https://stalker.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_mutants_in_Call_of_Pripyat'}[g];link.target='_blank';link.rel='noopener noreferrer';card.append(link)
   }else{card.append(mk('p','','В релизной версии этой игры как данный вид не представлен. Не смешивать с модификациями и вырезанными сборками.'))}
   cards.append(card)
  }
  const choose=target=>{
   for(const [g,card] of Object.entries(map))card.hidden=(target!=='all'&&g!==target);
   cards.style.gridTemplateColumns=target==='all'?'':'minmax(0,1fr)';
   for(const [g,button] of Object.entries(buttons))button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(target===g));
  };
  for(const [code,name] of [['all','ВСЕ'],['ТЧ','ТЧ'],['ЧН','ЧН'],['ЗП','ЗП']]){
   const b=mk('button','',name);b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(code==='all'));b.setAttribute('aria-label',code==='all'?'Показать все три игры':'Показать '+games[code]);b.onclick=()=>choose(code);buttons[code]=b;switches.append(b)
  }
  bar.append(switches);layer.append(bar,cards,mk('p','m646-caution','ВАЖНО: '+m.caution),mk('p','m646-caption',m.caption+' Оценка опасности — редакционная, не официальный числовой параметр.'));
  hero.closest('.dossier-media')?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',layer);
  choose('all');
 }
};
})();
</script>
<style id="archium-v647-css">
.v647-extra,.v647-weapon{margin:16px 0;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(226,166,65,.3);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(26,34,30,.92),rgba(13,21,22,.94));color:#e3e8e3;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.17)}
.v647-extra h3,.v647-weapon h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:#f0bd66;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:16px}.v647-intro{color:#a9b9b2;margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px}.v647-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.v647-fact{border:1px solid rgba(185,198,181,.15);border-radius:9px;padding:11px;background:rgba(4,9,10,.35);min-width:0}.v647-fact strong{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#eeb45c;margin-bottom:7px}.v647-fact p{margin:0;line-height:1.5;font-size:13px;color:#d4ded6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.v647-sources{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px}.v647-sources a{color:#ffd28a;text-underline-offset:3px}.v647-wlabel{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #836b3c;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 10px;margin:0 5px 8px 0;font-size:11px;color:#ffcf91}.v647-warning{background:#3528197d;border-left:3px solid #f0ad52;border-radius:5px;margin:10px 0 0;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}.v647-inline-btn{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:#ffe0ad;background:#2b281d;border:1px solid #6c5326;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 10px;margin:5px 6px 0 0}.v647-inline-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffc66a;outline-offset:3px}.v647-alt{font-size:12px;color:#a9b9b2;margin:8px 0 0}.v647-weapon .v647-grid{margin-top:12px}@media(max-width:640px){.v647-extra,.v647-weapon{padding:12px;margin:12px 0}.v647-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.v647-fact p{font-size:13px}.v647-weapon h3,.v647-extra h3{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v647-extra,.v647-weapon{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>

const make=(tag,cls,txt)=>{const el=document.createElement(tag);if(cls)el.className=cls;if(txt!==undefined)el.textContent=txt;return el};
function mkblock(title,body){const div=make('div','v647-fact'),b=make('strong','',title),p=make('p','',body);div.append(b,p);return div}
function source(container,url){if(!/^https:\/\//.test(url))return;const row=make('div','v647-sources'),a=make('a','','Проверить факты в источнике ↗');a.href=url;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';row.append(a);container.append(row)}
function mutant(x,root,hero){const data=CONTENT.mutants[x.name];if(!data)return;const mount=root.querySelector('.m646-root');if(!mount)return;const panel=make('section','v647-extra');panel.setAttribute('aria-label','Дополнительные материалы о мутанте');panel.append(make('h3','','◈ ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ ПОЛЕВЫЕ СВЕДЕНИЯ'),make('p','v647-intro','Поведение • игровые встречи • тактика • границы канона'));const grid=make('div','v647-grid');for(const [field,title] of [['nature','ПРОИСХОЖДЕНИЕ И ОСОБЕННОСТИ'],['evidence','ИГРОВЫЕ ПРИМЕРЫ'],['field','СОВЕТЫ ДЛЯ ИГРОКА'],['boundary','НЕ ПУТАТЬ']])grid.append(mkblock(title,data[field]));panel.append(grid);source(panel,data.source);mount.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',panel)}
function weapon(x,root,hero){const data=CONTENT.weapons[x.id];if(!data)return;const panel=make('section','v647-weapon');panel.setAttribute('aria-label','Паспорт оружия: '+x.name);panel.append(make('h3','','◈ ПАСПОРТ АРСЕНАЛА'),make('p','v647-intro','Проверка роли записи в каталоге • без выдуманных параметров урона'));panel.append(make('span','v647-wlabel',data.label),make('span','v647-wlabel',data.archetype));const grid=make('div','v647-grid');grid.append(mkblock('ТАКТИЧЕСКАЯ РОЛЬ',data.role),mkblock('СТАТУС В БАЗЕ',data.label==='Базовая модель'?'Основная карточка оружия. Варианты и именные экземпляры следует рассматривать отдельно.':'Не всякая запись в каталоге является отдельной базовой моделью оружия.'));if(data.fact)grid.append(mkblock('ПОДТВЕРЖДЁННЫЕ СВЕДЕНИЯ',data.fact));panel.append(grid);if(data.parents.length){const fam=make('div','v647-sources'),title=make('span','','Связанное оружие: ');fam.append(title);data.parents.forEach(pid=>{const target=window.ARCHIUM_WEAPON_DB_V647?.[pid];const btn=make('button','v647-inline-btn',target?.name||pid);btn.type='button';btn.onclick=()=>{const related=document.querySelector(`.entry-list [data-id="${pid}"]`);if(related){related.click();return}if(typeof selectEntry==='function'){selectEntry(pid,true);return}const list=document.getElementById('entry-list');const xbtn=Array.from(list?.querySelectorAll('button')||[]).find(el=>el.textContent.includes(target?.name||pid));if(xbtn){xbtn.click();return}list?.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('archium-weapon-navigate',{detail:{id:pid}}))};fam.append(btn)});panel.append(fam)}for(const warning of data.warnings)panel.append(make('p','v647-warning','⚠ '+warning));panel.append(make('p','v647-alt','Игры по текущему каталогу: '+(data.games||'не указаны')+'. Этот список не заменяет проверку точной игровой версии.'));if(data.source)source(panel,data.source);const media=hero?.closest?.('.dossier-media');if(media)media.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',panel);else root.append(panel)}
window.ARCHIUM_V647={mutant,weapon};
})();
</script>
<style id="archium-v648-arsenal-css">
.a648-root{margin:14px 0;padding:15px;border:1px solid rgba(218,172,95,.40);border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(31,36,33,.96),rgba(16,24,25,.97));color:#e9e8e0;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.a648-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(219,183,105,.20);padding-bottom:11px}
.a648-head h3{margin:0;color:#f3bd6c;font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.045em}.a648-head p{margin:3px 0 0;color:#aebbb4;font-size:12px}
.a648-mark{border:1px solid rgba(245,191,99,.38);color:#ecc27f;border-radius:5px;font-size:10px;padding:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.a648-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:12px 0}
.a648-tile{padding:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.075);border-radius:9px;min-width:0}
.a648-label{display:block;color:#efb85d;font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:5px}
.a648-tile strong,.a648-tile p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:0}
.a648-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:12px 0 9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.a648-tabs button{cursor:pointer;min-height:38px;flex:1;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(221,164,67,.3);background:#232b2b;color:#dce2dc;padding:7px 10px;font:inherit;font-size:12px}
.a648-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#553619;border-color:#e1a54c;color:#fff1db;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #a77534 inset}
.a648-panel{display:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding:12px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.17)}
.a648-panel[data-active="true"]{display:block}
.a648-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.a648-stat{padding:9px;border:1px solid #434d43;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(93,109,86,.11)}

<script id="archium-v648-weapons-engine">
(()=>{'use strict';
const records=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('archium-v648-weapons-data').textContent);
const prior=window.ARCHIUM_V647?.weapon;
if(typeof prior!=='function')return;
const mk=(tag,cls,t)=>{const e=document.createElement(tag);if(cls)e.className=cls;if(t!==undefined)e.textContent=t;return e};
const link=(url,txt)=>{const a=mk('a','a648-src',txt);a.href=url;a.rel='noopener noreferrer';a.target='_blank';return a};
function mount(x,root,hero){
 const r=records[x.id];if(!r)return;
 const box=mk('section','a648-root');box.setAttribute('aria-label','Расширенный оружейный протокол: '+r.name);
 const head=mk('div','a648-head');const title=mk('div');title.append(mk('h3','','◈ БАЛЛИСТИЧЕСКИЙ АРХИВ'),mk('p','','Издание 6.48 / справочные значения строго по отдельным играм'));
 head.append(title,mk('span','a648-mark','СВЕРКА · '+x.id));box.append(head);
 const quick=mk('div','a648-quick');
 const addQuick=(l,v)=>{const t=mk('div','a648-tile');t.append(mk('span','a648-label',l),mk('strong','',v));quick.append(t)};
 addQuick('ТИП ЗАПИСИ',r.type);addQuick('ПАТРОН / СНАРЯЖЕНИЕ',r.ammo);
 box.append(quick);
 if(r.duplicate){const item=window.ARCHIUM_WEAPON_DB_V647?.[r.duplicate];box.append(mk('p','a648-alert','↔ Схожее или повторное досье: '+(item?.name||r.duplicate)+'. Сравнить название и версию игры; это не дополнительная модель.'))}
 if(r.note)box.append(mk('p','a648-note',r.note));
 const tabs=mk('div','a648-tabs');tabs.setAttribute('role','group');tabs.setAttribute('aria-label','Выбор игры для справочных характеристик');
 const panels=mk('div','a648-panels');let buttons=[];let pages=[];
 for(const code of ['ТЧ','ЧН','ЗП']){
  const b=mk('button','',code);b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');tabs.append(b);buttons.push(b);
  const p=mk('div','a648-panel');p.dataset.game=code;p.dataset.active='false';pages.push(p);panels.append(p);
  const present=r.games.includes(code),fact=r.gameProfiles[code];
  if(!present){p.append(mk('p','a648-empty','В текущем каталоге эта игра не отмечена для записи. Прежде чем считать оружие отсутствующим в релизе, нужна дополнительная сверка.'));continue}
  if(fact){
   const arr=[['Магазин',fact.mag,'патронов'],['Темп огня',fact.rpm,'выстр./мин'],['Урон',fact.damage,'условн. ед.'],['Цена',fact.price,'игровых ед.']].filter(([,v])=>v!==undefined);
   if(arr.length){const stats=mk('div','a648-stats');for(const [label,v,unit] of arr){const card=mk('div','a648-stat');card.append(mk('strong','',String(v)),mk('small','',label+' · '+unit));stats.append(card)}p.append(stats)}
   if(fact.caliber)p.append(mk('p','a648-note','Основной боеприпас: '+fact.caliber));
   if(fact.note)p.append(mk('p','a648-note',fact.note));
   if(fact.source)p.append(link(fact.source,fact.authority==='official'?'Официальный справочник разработчиков ↗':'Справочник сообщества / перепроверить ↗'));
   if(fact.authority==='official')p.append(mk('span','a648-flag','Числовые данные: официальный паспорт указанной игры; обычная модификация, если не сказано иначе.'));
   if(fact.authority==='community')p.append(mk('span','a648-flag','Источник: сообщество. Для точных значений и точек получения нужна дополнительная сверка.'));
